deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint, alias :large-model-benchmark): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package. Pruned dependencies whose :local/root points outside the repository: kotoba-lang/document-contracts (no such repository).

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

test/bim_test.cljk.reason: The suite opens fixture files by a path relative to the old repository root (test/...). The library suites run from the root of this repository, so each such path names the file where it now lives (lib/kotoba.bim/test/...). Nothing else in the file changes.
